t: This is Fulham Cemetery, just off Fulham Palace Road. It was designed by John Hall and opened in 1865. Several people are buried here. George Barnes was a trade union leader and Labour politician, who led the Labour Party from 1910 to 1911. Jolly John Nash was a music hall singer and comedian, known for his laughing songs. Alfred John Kempe, an antiquary, is also buried here, as is Lawrence Palk, the second Baron Haldon, a peer.
